text:
Alex: quick idea — what if route cards in Console show a tiny routing-preview badge? main model + fallback chain + a token-cost delta for saved views. helps teams pick the right default when they save per-route views.

Mira: +1. hover could expand to show 1) p95 latency per model, 2) avg tokens/savedview (estimate), 3) last 24h error rate. small UX, big helpful context. :sparkles:

Sam: fyi we should avoid extra live calls on page load. we can rely on precomputed aggregates from telemetry. backend should return a compact preview blob for each route in the routes list. client caches for 5m.

Ben: agreed. proposed new contract on GET /v1/routes?include=preview -> adds `route_preview` field with {models: ["x","y"], cost_delta: 0.023, latency_ms: 120, sample_count: 240}. Example: 

```
GET /v1/routes?include=preview
200 OK
[
  {"id":"r-123","name":"login","route_preview":"gpt-4o -> gpt-4o-q4, cost_delta: +0.02, p95_ms: 160"}
]
```

Tia: UX: keep the visible badge minimal: show primary model shortname and a small chevron that expands to the preview panel. If cost_delta > threshold show a subtle warning. avoid clutter on compact route lists.

Mira: also surface routing policy that would trigger fallback (capacity, latency, cost). devs care about why a save will hit a fallback. e.g., "Primary: 4o (reserved), fallback: 4o-q4 (ondemand)"

Sam: backend note — to compute this reliably we need: per-route model distribution + current capacity policy + configured rollouts. That is a join across telemetry, routing-config, and deployments. We can approximate with daily aggregates while we productize real-time.

Ben: implementation plan suggestion:
- Phase 1: Add precomputed preview fields (daily roll-up) to route index (no infra change to live router). cheap and fast.
- Phase 2: include short-lived freshness token and hook to routing service for live peek (opt-in).

Alex: timeline? I'd like a prototype in Console next sprint behind a feature flag so PMs can test with a couple customers.

Sam: I'll mock the preview endpoint and add a naive cache. backend PR: https://git.redwood/repo/pulls/1245 (WIP).

Tia: I'll wire up the compact badge and hover panel in the UI kit. will keep it keyboard accessible.

Mira: can we include a tiny telemetry link in the panel: "view route metrics" -> opens telemetry explorer with filters for that route & last 7d? helps validation.

Ben: yep, we'll populate the panel with links: telemetry, model-rollout config, and a small note about cost math.

DeployBot: Deploy preview available — env: staging, url: https://stg-console.redwood/route-preview-ux — branch: feature/route-preview-badge

Alex: awesome. next steps: Sam finish mock endpoint + PR, Tia build flag UI, Ben coordinate rollup job, Mira prepare PM test script. check back in on Monday. :thumbsup:

Sam: noted. I'll add the API contract to the backend RFC doc today.

Ben: created infra ticket INF-678 to schedule the rollup batch.

Alex: closing this thread for now. we'll reopen when the staging preview is ready for PM testing. thanks everyone!
